memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Type 2 diabetes
  Status: newly diagnosed, symptomatic with polyuria and fatigue.
  Plan: start metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD; check weight and waist; diet advice: breakfast - reduced carbs, lunch - moderate protein, dinner - light veg.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  Status: low B12 causing mild tingling.
  Plan: methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; recheck B12 in 3 months.
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux
  Status: heartburn after meals, no alarm symptoms.
  Plan: pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast; antacid gel SOS; domperidone 10 mg BD before meals; avoid spicy food, elevate head of bed.
Weight 68 kg, waist 88 cm (male cut‑off 90 cm).
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Type 2 diabetes
  Status: improved glycaemia, one episode of mild hypoglycaemia.
  Plan: reduce sitagliptin to 50 mg OD; continue metformin, glimepiride, empagliflozin; reinforce snack before exercise.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  Status: asymptomatic, B12 pending.
  Plan: continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux
  Status: well controlled, occasional breakthrough.
  Plan: continue pantoprazole 40 mg OD; domperidone 10 mg BD as needed; review need for H. pylori stool antigen if symptoms persist.
Weight 66 kg, waist 86 cm.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-10-10.
